// Inspect shipped loader/configuration only; no DOM, browser, or typesetting.
const fs = require('node:fs');
const vm = require('node:vm');
const bundle = fs.readFileSync('internal/webui/static/vendor/tex-svg.js', 'utf8');
const marker = 'var __webpack_exports__={};';
if (bundle.split(marker).length !== 2) throw Error('unexpected bundle boundary');
const source = bundle.replace(marker,
  'globalThis.defenseModule=__webpack_require__;globalThis.defenseModules=__webpack_modules__;return;' + marker);
const fixture = {document: {currentScript: {src: 'http://defense.invalid/static/vendor/tex-svg.js'}},
  MathJax: {tex: {inlineMath: [['$', '$']]}, svg: {fontCache: 'global'}}, console};
vm.runInNewContext(source, fixture);
const loader = fixture.defenseModule(235);
console.log(JSON.stringify({version: fixture.defenseModule(3282).VERSION}));
for (const extension of ['color', 'physics']) {
  console.log(JSON.stringify({extension,
    path: loader.Package.resolvePath('[mathjax]/input/tex/extensions/' + extension)}));
}
for (const [id, factory] of Object.entries(fixture.defenseModules)) {
  if (!factory.toString().includes('AutoloadConfiguration')) continue;
  const mod = fixture.defenseModule(Number(id));
  const cfg = mod.AutoloadConfiguration;
  if (cfg) console.log(JSON.stringify({module: id, configuration: cfg.name, options: cfg.options}));
}
